Changed the channel name: GA - Repeal "Land Reclamation Regulation"
Very strong against, bad resolution, GOATd author of the OG resolution

> Noting that Article 4 of GA#526 requires member states "to conduct impact studies to determine if proceeding with land reclamation will not violate" its provisions, even though Article 1b defines an impact study as "an independent survey conducted to determine the potential ecological impacts of land reclamation,"
:thinkpika:
@Wallenburg do you find this stuff credible?
It relies on 526§4 being logically impossible to comply with.
Which may just be the case but that's a fucking *tall* order to meet the standard required to argue compliance is impossible.
In this context, “conduct” could reasonably mean “to organize” or “to manage” more than “to directly carry out”
“Independent” would be the bigger issue come to think of it. Resolution doesn’t say independent of *what*
If I tell an organization to conduct an independent study, there’s no logical way I’m requiring that study to be independent of the organization doing it lol
Counterargument there would be that I'm assuming said organization isn't also doing the land reclamation project. "Independent" still has to mean something
You could also say that "determine if proceeding with land reclamation will not violate this resolution" doesn't specify whose reclamation, something the repeal itself implicitly acknowledges
Bumfuckistan wants to do reclamation, asks shitderpistan to do a study
All that's needed is some reasonable interpretation that allows for any situation where a member can do land reclamation

This is a plausible reading, but it's not a rational one, as it would make noncompliance assured. 

I think any reasonable nation would have to define conducting a study or an "independent survey" in such a way as to allow compliance in some fashion, and for that reason, I find the repeal's argument weak, but not illegal.
If this is challenged, the defense is going to be “it’s not illegal, just dishonest”
